title: smtp: drop usenet-ipfs-sieve dep; change license to MIT; update CLAUDE.md
description:
Remove the AGPL dep from smtp and update all license declarations.

What: crates/smtp/Cargo.toml, CLAUDE.md

Algorithm:
1. crates/smtp/Cargo.toml: remove 'usenet-ipfs-sieve = { path = "../sieve" }' line; change license field from 'AGPL-3.0-only' to 'MIT'.
2. Verify 'cargo tree -p usenet-ipfs-smtp' contains no reference to sieve-rs or usenet-ipfs-sieve.
3. CLAUDE.md license section: update to reflect that usenet-ipfs-smtp is now MIT; only usenet-ipfs-sieve and usenet-ipfs-sieve-daemon remain AGPL.
4. cargo build --workspace must succeed with no sieve-rs in the smtp dep tree.

Defensive rules:
- Do not remove the dep until W3A and W3B are complete (this bead depends on both).
- Verify with 'cargo tree' not just by eyeballing Cargo.toml.
